organic.title: Nordvale Materials Names Jane Doe Chief Financial Officer
organic.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio, Feb. 1, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- Nordvale Materials Inc. today announced the appointment of Jane Doe as Chief Financial Officer, effective February 1, 2024. Doe succeeds interim CFO Alan Pryce.

organic.title: Nordvale Materials Announces Departure of Chief Operating Officer Marcus Hall
organic.description: Nordvale Materials Inc. ("Nordvale") announced that Chief Operating Officer Marcus Hall will depart the company effective September 30, 2025, to pursue other opportunities.

organic.title: Priya Raghavan joins Nordvale Materials as Chief Technology Officer
organic.description: Priya Raghavan has joined Columbus-based Nordvale Materials Inc. as chief technology officer, the company said Monday.
